turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Totally unrelated, but you're good with words.
I didn't come for compliments. Was he heard first, yes or no?
I have to email a parent tonight about a fight in the cafeteria. Could you help me word it?
That's your email to write, Hale. I'll take your silence as a no: nobody spoke to my son first.
Just a couple of sentences. You'd nail it.
No. What do you have on Owen's essay besides the checker?
